info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Treasury Securities Financings-spec
info.description: This API provides access to a comprehensive list of treasury securities financings available within the system. Users can retrieve detailed information about various financing options, including terms and conditions, rates, and available amounts. It serves financial institutions, traders, and analysts who need up-to-date data to inform their treasury operations and investment decisions. By utilizing this API, developers can integrate treasury financing data into their applications, enabling enhanced financial analysis and reporting.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about securities financing activities. It provides insights into available instruments and financing options, helping stakeholders make informed decisions in treasury management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve securities financing data for treasury operations. It includes necessary parameters that dictate what data is being requested.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested securities financing data.
